entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: Haaahahahaha! Today was truly a[n]wonderful experience.

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: Though I lost yesterday, so my winning[n]average is still only fifty percent so far...

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: Gambling is the ideal pastime for the[n]rich. Only fools think about actually[n]trying to win here.

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: Spending money and wasting time in[n]the same instant... Isn't that the ultimate[n]form of luxury?

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: Although I will say, I do like to win[n]every now and again. Hahahaha!

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: I've been to the other casinos, but this is[n]my first time in the entertainment hall.

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: You know there are casino areas all over[n]this ship, right?

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: I'm certain the gentleman I saw at the[n]slots downstairs is a television exec...

entries.speaker: Masked Guest
entries.en: I heard he loves gambling... He must be[n]moving around to the various casinos in[n]here.
